# Liu et al. (2019) data comparison

Liu H, Gleason SM, Hao G, Hua L, He P, Goldstein G, Ye Q. 2019. Hydraulic traits are coordinated with maximum plant height at the global scale. Science Advances 5: eaav1332.
https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/sciadv.aav1332


## Loading all required packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(terra)
library(APCalign)
library(glmmTMB)
library(easystats)
library(ggeffects)
library(scales)
```


## Loading all required data
```{r}
Liu2019 <- read.csv("./data/reference_liu2019.csv", header = T) |> drop_na(Vdia, MAP)


Liu2019 <- Liu2019 |> 
  mutate(log_Vdia = log(Vdia),
    log_MAP = log(MAP)) |> # Switch to MAP or AI depending on what you are looking for
  group_by(Genus) |> 
  mutate(
    genus_mean_MAP = mean(log_MAP),
    genus_mean_Vdia = mean(log_Vdia)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    diff_from_genus_MAP = log_MAP - genus_mean_MAP,
  )


```


## Model comparison
```{r}
# Mixed model with genus-centering
Liu_mixed_model <- glmmTMB(log_Vdia ~ genus_mean_MAP + 
                                  diff_from_genus_MAP +
                                  (1 | Family) + 
                                  (diff_from_genus_MAP | Genus),
                                data = Liu2019,
                                family = gaussian())

# Mixed model testing
parameters(Liu_mixed_model)
summary(Liu_mixed_model)
r2(Liu_mixed_model)

# Simple model
Liu_regular_model <- glmmTMB(log_Vdia ~ log_MAP,
                                data = Liu2019,
                                family = gaussian())

# Simple model testing
parameters(Liu_regular_model)
summary(Liu_regular_model)
r2(Liu_regular_model)

# Comparison
compare_performance(Liu_regular_model, Liu_mixed_model)
anova(Liu_regular_model, Liu_mixed_model)
```

## Quick plot
```{r}
# ==========================================
# 📊 LIU MIXED MODEL PREDICTIONS
# ==========================================

# --- Simple prediction ---
Liu_simple_pred <- ggpredict(Liu_regular_model, terms = "log_MAP [all]")

# --- Within-genus predictions (per genus, including genus-level random slopes) ---
Liu_within_pred_list <- lapply(unique(Liu2019$Genus), function(g) {
  genus_data <- Liu2019[Liu2019$Genus == g, ]
  if (nrow(genus_data) < 2) return(NULL)

  genus_mean <- unique(genus_data$genus_mean_MAP)[1]
  fam        <- unique(genus_data$Family)[1]
  diff_range <- seq(min(genus_data$diff_from_genus_MAP),
                    max(genus_data$diff_from_genus_MAP),
                    length.out = 50)

  pred_data <- data.frame(
    genus_mean_MAP      = genus_mean,
    diff_from_genus_MAP = diff_range,
    Genus               = g,
    Family              = fam
  )

  pred_vals <- predict(Liu_mixed_model,
                       newdata          = pred_data,
                       re.form          = NULL,   # ✅ include all REs (genus slope + family intercept)
                       type             = "response",
                       allow.new.levels = TRUE)

  data.frame(x_scaled  = genus_mean + diff_range,
             predicted = pred_vals,
             genus     = g)
})
Liu_within_pred_scaled <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), Liu_within_pred_list))

# --- Across-genus prediction (vary genus_mean_MAP; diff_from_genus_MAP = 0; no random effects) ---
Liu_map_range <- seq(min(Liu2019$genus_mean_MAP),
                     max(Liu2019$genus_mean_MAP),
                     length.out = 100)

Liu_across_pred <- data.frame(
  x         = Liu_map_range,
  predicted = predict(Liu_mixed_model,
                      newdata = data.frame(genus_mean_MAP      = Liu_map_range,
                                           diff_from_genus_MAP = 0),
                      re.form = NA,
                      type    = "response")
)

# --- Average within-genus prediction (fixed diff_from_genus_MAP slope only; genus_mean_MAP held at mean) ---
Liu_diff_range      <- seq(min(Liu2019$diff_from_genus_MAP),
                            max(Liu2019$diff_from_genus_MAP),
                            length.out = 100)
Liu_mean_genus_MAP  <- mean(Liu2019$genus_mean_MAP)

Liu_avg_within_pred <- data.frame(
  x_scaled  = Liu_mean_genus_MAP + Liu_diff_range,
  predicted = predict(Liu_mixed_model,
                      newdata = data.frame(genus_mean_MAP      = Liu_mean_genus_MAP,
                                           diff_from_genus_MAP = Liu_diff_range),
                      re.form = NA,
                      type    = "response")
)

# ==========================================
# 📝 MODIFIABLE LEGEND TEXT & PROPERTIES
# ==========================================
line_labels <- c(
  "Within-genus"       = "Within-genus",
  "Simple regression"  = "Simple regression",
  "Across-genus"       = "Across-genus",
  "Average within-genus" = "Avg. within-genus"
)
line_colors <- c(
  "Within-genus"         = "grey50",
  "Simple regression"    = "red",
  "Across-genus"         = "black",
  "Average within-genus" = "blue"
)
line_types <- c(
  "Within-genus"         = "solid",
  "Simple regression"    = "dashed",
  "Across-genus"         = "solid",
  "Average within-genus" = "solid"
)

# ==========================================
# 🎨 OPTIONAL: define axis breaks manually
# ==========================================
# Liu_Vdia_y_breaks <- log(c(...))  # e.g. log(c(10, 50, 200, 1000))
# Liu_Vdia_x_breaks <- log(c(...))  # e.g. log(c(200, 500, 1000, 2500))

# ==========================================
# 📈 LIU Vdia PLOT
# ==========================================
Liu_Vdia_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = Liu2019,
             aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Vdia),
             colour = "grey40", size = 1, alpha = 1, shape = 1) +
  geom_line(data = Liu_within_pred_scaled,
            aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted, group = genus, color = "Within-genus"),
            linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 0.1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = as_tibble(Liu_simple_pred),
            aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = "Simple regression"),
            linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = Liu_across_pred,
            aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = "Across-genus"),
            linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = Liu_avg_within_pred,
            aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted, color = "Average within-genus"),
            linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name   = "Response type",
    values = line_colors,
    labels = line_labels
  ) +
  # Uncomment and supply breaks once you inspect the data range:
  # scale_y_continuous(breaks = Liu_Vdia_y_breaks,
  #                    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
  #                    name   = expression(italic(V)[dia] ~ "(μm²)")) +
  # scale_x_continuous(breaks = Liu_Vdia_x_breaks,
  #                    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
  #                    name   = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
                     name   = expression(italic(V)[dia] ~ "(μm²)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
                     name   = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 7.5, face = "bold"),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    strip.text        = element_text(face = "italic")
  )

Liu_Vdia_plot
```
